Market today: The mood is cautious, with the Nasdaq-100 nearing correction and semiconductor stocks taking a beating. The real driver is ongoing pressure on tech and chip names, amplified by concerns over AI spending.

Your holdings: QQQ, SMH, SOXL, and QQQI are all flagged SELL. SOXL is down a painful 56.96%, and SMH is down 16.78%. SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is also down significantly. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your semiconductor exposure (SMH, SOXL) and the broader Nasdaq-100 (QQQ, QQQI) for further weakness. Microsoft's AI gamble is also a key watch.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your concentrated, leveraged tech/chip book, especially respecting stops.
plays: Trim SOXL given its deep -56.96% loss and leveraged nature; re-evaluate your default stop at 200.
Respect the SMH stop at 540 and monitor QQQ closely around its 670 stop; QQQI is also a SELL and near its 52 stop.
Consider a tactical long on MSFT at 392.96-392.56 with a stop at 391.78, aligning with its AI focus and scanner setup.
